race.comment: IMMORTAL TRIUMPH (8) won two on the bounce prior to last start at Caulfield Heath when fading. He can settle handy and bounce back. BARDIA'S DREAM (15) was poor last time when in the market but did go well on heavy ground at Seymour prior and that form reads well. Include. DELICATE LADY (2) was responsible for a better run last time out when third over 1100m at this track, beaten a long neck. Has wet-track form and can threaten here. VOLATILE (18) hasn't won for more than a year but ran a solid race 17 days ago when third over 1200m at Mornington. Handles the conditions and is worth including in wider plays.
